mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, negatively impacting corporate margins and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE declines by more than 0.5pp in a month and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 2% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST levels are high and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where during a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a restrictive monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month during a tightening cycle and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising GDP (GDPC1) and falling Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates a decoupling of economic growth from consumer demand, which can lead to a misallocation of resources and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases simultaneously and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances over a 3-year period.
